t: This is The Gardener, a sculpture by Karin Jonzen. She was a British figure sculptor, born Karin Löwenadler, who worked in bronze, terracotta and stone. Her work was commissioned by a number of public bodies in Britain and abroad, so a piece like this one sits within a wider body of public art. Take a moment to look at the figure itself, how it is posed and what it is doing, since Jonzen was a sculptor of the human figure above all.
